features: State capsules on the main Terminal cards now remove the star rating and switch to solid filled gradient pills, keeping the original S-state text but upgrading the look to a subtle 3D cyberpunk capsule.
Sector/category text next to each symbol no longer uses a green capsule. It now renders as compact plain text, matching the approved reference style.

The sticky top filter row keeps the same filtering logic but switches to neutral capsules with colored status dots: S3 yellow, S0.5 purple, S1 blue, S2 green, S0 white, OTHER dark, while ALL stays text-only and PW remains available for US-stock.

Top action labels are restyled to neutral emphasis: 近期戰績 uses the 📊 icon, 完整分析 uses the 📝 icon, and both controls remove the previous green accent while keeping existing behavior and availability logic.
No chart geometry, CCI pane, BB/HA linework, probability logic, Worker/API behavior, research blocks, PW mapping, or other unrequested UI sections are changed in this release.
